story:
Advanced Electrical and Communications, LLC is a licensed electrical contractor based at 311 Simpson St. in Dupont, Pennsylvania, serving homeowners, businesses and contractors across the greater Northeastern Pennsylvania area.

We specialize in residential electrical service and repair, and we take on commercial and industrial work of any size alongside low voltage and communications wiring — the systems that don't run standard household power, like structured data cabling and security wiring. Whatever the job, large or small, we're standing by to meet the need.

When it comes to protecting your home or business, you need an electrician who knows what to look for. Every electrician on our team is licensed and trained to spot safety hazards and flag each concern, not just fix the one problem that prompted the call. That's the standard we hold ourselves to on every job.

Our regular hours are Monday through Friday, 7:00am to 3:30pm, and we offer emergency service outside of that window for problems that can't wait. Customers keep coming back to us for our knowledge and expertise, but they stay for our quick, on-time service and the level of care we bring to every job.
